title: Nielsen classes in outer automorphism groups of free groups
summary: For every $n\ge 8$, we construct explicit families of generating pairs of $GL(n,\mathbb Z)$ and $SL(n,\mathbb Z)$ representing countably infinitely many Nielsen equivalence classes. These pairs arise as the homology images of explicit torsion generating pairs in $Out(F_n)$ and its index-two subgroup $SOut(F_n)$, yielding countably infinitely many Nielsen classes of generating pairs in both outer groups.
